contracts.description: Author Exhibits: static multi-page websites (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, media, WebAssembly) that a Person views inside Teamarness. Store each file (file.write for text, file.put for binary), then create or replace a Draft that names them; read text back with file.text. Call runtime.guide first.

ports.name: runtime.guide
ports.description: Read this first. Returns how to author an Exhibit as Markdown, plus the enforced limits, the allowed extensions with their media types (lowercase extensions only) and the Exhibit ID pattern. Exhibits bundle every file: no CDN or network, relative links only, one entry page, no workers or nested frames.

ports.name: file.put
ports.description: Upload one chunk of a file named by its lowercase hex SHA-256 and size. data is standard base64 of exactly 131072 raw bytes, except the last chunk; chunkCount is ceil(size / 131072), or 1 for an empty file. Chunks are idempotent and may arrive in any order; complete is true once the file is verified and stored. Files over 16 MiB are refused (exhibits.too_large). Keep at most 4 calls in flight. After outcome_unknown, ask files.missing instead of guessing.

ports.name: file.write
ports.description: Store one whole text file (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SVG, JSON, Markdown) by sending its content as text, at most 98304 bytes of UTF-8 (exhibits.too_large otherwise; split larger files). Control characters other than tab and line breaks fail with exhibits.not_text. Returns its sha256 and size: pass that sha256 with the file's path to draft.update. Never compute hashes or base64 yourself. Repeating the same text is safe. Use file.put only for binary files or when a program computes the hash.

ports.name: files.missing
ports.description: Report which of up to 256 files are not yet stored completely: chunks is "all" when nothing was received, or the chunk indices to send. Files already stored are left out, so an empty list means every file is present. Use it before uploading, to skip files another Exhibit already stored, and to resume after an uncertain file.put.

ports.name: draft.update
ports.description: Create the Draft exhibitId, or replace its title, entry page and complete file list atomically, and return the new revision. Every file must be uploaded first; otherwise exhibits.missing_files names them. Pass expectedRevision (0 for a new Draft) to avoid overwriting another update: exhibits.revision_conflict carries the current revision. Other refusals: exhibits.invalid_id, invalid_title, invalid_path, type_refused, too_large.

ports.name: exhibit.list
ports.description: List Exhibits newest first by last update, at most 64 per page. Pass nextBefore back as before for the next page; it is absent on the last page. Every Exhibit is a Draft in this version.

ports.name: exhibit.read
ports.description: Read a Draft's title, entry page, revision, who last updated it (person or agent) and files (path, sha256, size, mediaType), sorted by path, 500 files per page; pass nextOffset back as offset for the next page. Read a text file's content with file.text, and binary bytes with file.read. Unknown IDs fail with exhibits.not_found.

ports.name: file.read
ports.description: Read one 131072-byte chunk of a stored file as standard base64, with the file's chunkCount, for binary files or a program that decodes base64. Read text files with file.text instead. Files not stored completely fail with exhibits.not_found.

ports.name: file.text
ports.description: Read a stored text file (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SVG, JSON, Markdown) as plain UTF-8 text, so you can revise content you did not keep. Returns at most maxBytes bytes (default 8192, at most 98304) from offset (default 0), ending on a character boundary, with the file's size; nextOffset is present while more text remains: pass it back as offset. Take each file's sha256 from exhibit.read. Binary content fails with exhibits.not_text (use file.read); files not stored completely fail with exhibits.not_found.

ports.name: draft.delete
ports.description: Delete a Draft; deleted is false when it did not exist, so a repeat is safe. Pass expectedRevision to refuse deleting an update you have not seen (exhibits.revision_conflict). Its files stay stored for 24 hours, so recreating it soon needs no upload.
